critical_code_review_comments: server.py:6392 - the tuple-assignment 'upper, lower = {...}, {...} if k else set()' relies on Python precedence (ternary binds only to the second tuple element). Works for current call sites because k==0 implies ranked is empty so both set comprehensions yield empty sets, but the intent is unclear. Suggest 'if k==0: upper=lower=set()' then compute afterwards.
server.py:6383 - bucket index formula '-(-int(p*100)//1000)-1' is correct but opaque; replace with 'min(9, int(p//10))' guarded for p==0.
